pretexts: boss working offsite needs gift cards for employee rewards
family member or friend needs help buying gift cards
urgent wire transfer request from executive
existing client requests urgent wire transfer
head office reports problems with financial products
employee requests change to direct deposit information
supplier or contractor notifies of banking information change
landlord requests rent payment through different method due to bank account issue
interac_context: Fraudsters spoofing landlords ask tenants to send rent payment through e-transfer instead of usual arrangement, claiming bank account problems.

kill_chain_signals.contact: fraudster sends email or calls that appears to come from legitimate source using spoofing
kill_chain_signals.pretext: claims to be boss, client, head office, employee, supplier, or landlord with urgent request or change in payment details
kill_chain_signals.payment: directs victim to purchase gift cards, send wire transfer, conduct money transfers, or change direct deposit/rent payment method
kill_chain_signals.movement: payments directed to fraudulent accounts or gift card codes provided to fraudster
kill_chain_signals.cashout: wire transfers sent to foreign accounts

red_flags: unusual requests that claim to be from someone you work with
urgent requests for gift cards or wire transfers
requests to change payment details or banking information
emails with spelling and grammar errors
requests for payment method different from usual arrangement
key_quote: These frauds leverage existing relationships between the person receiving the email and the person sending it.
title: Spear phishing
